title: Mahjong Kaigan Monogatari: Mahjong-kyou Jidai Sexy Idol-hen
native_title: 麻雀海岸物語 ～麻雀狂時代セクシーアイドル編～
overview: Mahjong Kyō Jidai Sexy Idol Hen is one of several games in Micronet's series of strip mahjong games featuring video footage of real-life models. This particular entry features video clips of three fashionable young idols, who progressively undress down to either their underwear or a swimsuit -- though no further -- as the player wins matches. The unlocked videos of each girl can be freely rewatched from the menu.
